controls.question: What was the average available power in MW of PV resources on 2020-06-20?
controls.original_sql: SELECT resource_type, ROUND(AVG(available_mw), 3) AS avg_available_mw FROM renewable_availability_da WHERE resource_type = 'PV' AND timestamp >= '2020-06-20 00:00:00' AND timestamp < datetime('2020-06-20 00:00:00', '+1 day') GROUP BY resource_type;
